blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.
blocks.zh: 医学检查的准确性是临床使用语言模型的常见证据,然而一个打算用自己的硬件运行一个开放模型的卫生系统需要知道更多:模型是否承认可能错误时,医学微调是否改善了这种能力,其正确答案是否依赖于合理的临床推理,或者是否实际使用了它给出的图像. 在西班牙的MIR居住考试中,我们为四个80至270亿参数的开放模型来审查这些问题,根据考试本身的规则,从8个版本中得1 552个问题。 在回答每一个问题时,三个较大的模式将大致排在第一批600至3 000名候选人中,其中41至43个专业仍然开放。 然而,弃权从不给钱,因为即使他们最没有信心的答案也比25%的平分率更正确。 医学微调以准确性为代价降低了过度自信,而没有改善信心如何将正确与错误的答案区分开来. 此外,有13-38%的正确答复拒绝分心者,理由是临床上不健全,信心不能反映,删除或交换所提供的背景图像的准确性保持不变。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) now pass medical licensing examinations, often by a wide margin [ 21 , 31 , 25 , 20 ] , and the Spanish residency examination is no exception [ 11 ] . Most of this evidence, however, comes from large proprietary models accessed through closed APIs, whose weights are not available and whose prompting, decoding or training data remain outside the user’s control. A hospital that cannot send patient data beyond its own infrastructure must thus instead turn to open models that can run on its own hardware, which also gives it the ability to inspect, control and audit them [ 27 , 33 ] . At the scale that fits on a single workstation GPU of reasonable cost and memory, i.e., models of a few tens of billions of parameters, accuracy on medical examinations is far from a solved problem, and the question is whether the performance of these models is good enough to support clinical decision-making or education purposes.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模式(LLMs)现在通过医疗许可考试,通常使用宽差[21,31,25,20],西班牙居民考试也不例外[11]. 然而,这些证据大多来自通过封闭的API访问的大型专有型号,这些型号的权重不可用,而且其提示性、解码性或培训性数据仍然不受用户控制。 因此,不能将病人数据传送到自己的基础设施以外的医院必须转向可以使用自己的硬件运行的开放模型,这也使它有能力检查、控制和审计这些模型[27、33]。 在符合合理成本和内存的单个工作站GPU,即数以百亿计参数的模型上,体检的准确性远未解决,问题是这些模型的性能是否足以支持临床决策或教育目的.

blocks.en: Yet, a headline accuracy figure answers none of the questions that a health system would need to ask before deploying such a model for clinical decision support or medical education [ 13 ] . It says nothing about whether the model knows when it is wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves that self-knowledge or merely changes accuracy, whether a correct answer is reached through reasoning that a physician would consider clinically sound, or whether the model actually looks at the image when a case comes with one. A model can thus be confidently wrong, or right for the wrong reasons, without either showing in its score.
blocks.zh: 然而,一个标题的准确性数字并不会回答一个卫生系统在应用这种模型进行临床决策支持或医学教育之前需要提出的问题[13]。 它没有说明模型是否知道何时是错误的,医学微调是否改善了自我认知,还是仅仅改变了准确性,是否通过医生会考虑临床听力的推理得出了正确的答案,或者模型是否在病例出现时实际查看了图像. 因此,一个模型可能会自信地错误,或者由于错误的原因而正确,而不在其分数中显示.

blocks.en: The Spanish Médico Interno Residente (MIR) examination makes it possible to address all four questions under realistic conditions. Because it penalizes wrong answers, a candidate’s score depends on when they choose to answer or abstain; because it allocates training locations and specialties by rank, a score translates directly into a specialty and hospital where different candidates would be placed under various degrees of competitiveness; and because physicians publish per-option commentaries on many of its questions, and about one question in eight includes a clinical image, it also lends itself to an analysis of reasoning and image use. We evaluate four open models, namely Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, Gemma-3-27B and MedGemma-27B, the last two of which share a base model and differ only in medical tuning, and address the following research questions:
blocks.zh: 西班牙的Médico Interno居民(MIR)考试使得在现实条件下解决所有四个问题成为可能. 由于它惩罚错误的答案,考生的分数取决于他们选择何时回答或弃权;由于它按级别分配训练地点和特长,分数会直接转化为专业和医院,不同考生会被置于不同程度的竞争力之下;由于医生对其许多问题发表每个选项的评论,大约八分之一的问题包括一个临床图像,它也有利于对推理和图像使用的分析. 我们评价了四个开放型号,即:Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B,Gemma-3-27B和MedGemma-27B,其中后两个型号共用了一个基模型,只在医学调理上有所不同,并解决了以下研究问题:

blocks.en: RQ1. Scored like a real candidate, where does each model land in the national ranking? RQ2. Does medical fine-tuning improve a model’s judgement of its own uncertainty, or only its accuracy/practical performance? RQ3. When a model gets the answer right, does it reject the wrong options for reasons that a physician would consider clinically sound? RQ4. Do vision language models actually use the clinical images they are given, or do they answer instead from the text alone?
blocks.zh: RQ1 (英语). 像真正的候选人一样得分,全国排名中每个模范都在哪里? RQ2 (英语). 医学的微调能改善模型对自身不确定性的判断,还是只能提高它的准确性/实用性? RQ3 (英语). 当一个模型得到正确的答案,它是否拒绝错误的选择,因为医生会认为临床上是健全的? RQ4(英语:RQ 4. 视觉语言模型是实际使用他们得到的临床图像,还是只用文字回答?

blocks.en: Scored like a real candidate, where does each model land in the national ranking?
blocks.zh: 像真正的候选人一样得分,全国排名中每个模范都在哪里?

blocks.en: Does medical fine-tuning improve a model’s judgement of its own uncertainty, or only its accuracy/practical performance?
blocks.zh: 医学的微调能改善模型对自身不确定性的判断,还是只能提高它的准确性/实用性?

blocks.en: When a model gets the answer right, does it reject the wrong options for reasons that a physician would consider clinically sound?
blocks.zh: 当一个模型得到正确的答案,它是否拒绝错误的选择,因为医生会认为临床上是健全的?

blocks.en: Do vision language models actually use the clinical images they are given, or do they answer instead from the text alone?
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型是实际使用他们得到的临床图像,还是只用文字回答?

blocks.en: Our results show that a score good enough to win a competitive residency hides substantial weaknesses. The three larger models would rank among the first few thousand candidates and could choose almost any specialty, yet none of the four can profit from the exam’s penalty by abstaining, since even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical tuning makes a model less overconfident but also less accurate, and no better at telling its right answers from wrong ones. Between 13 and 38% of correct answers dismiss at least one wrong option for a clinically unsound reason, which the model’s confidence does not reveal, and withholding or swapping the clinical image leaves accuracy unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,如果分数够好,足以赢得竞争性居留权,就会掩盖重大弱点。 三个较大的模式将排在第一批几千名候选人中,并且可以选择几乎任何专业,然而四个人中没有一个能够通过弃权从考试的处罚中获利,因为即使他们最没有信心的答案也比25分平衡更经常正确。 医学调音使模型不那么自信,但也不太准确,从错误的答案中说出正确的答案也没有更好的效果. 13-38 % 的正确答案至少排除了一个错误的选择,因为临床上的理由不健全,而模型的信心并没有显示出来,而保留或交换临床图像的准确性保持不变。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: (i) a corpus of 2,595 questions extracted from the last twelve official MIR exams, from 2014 to 2025, with answer keys, physician commentary, clinical plates and the published score-to-rank data of the 2023 and 2024 calls; (ii) an evaluation under the exam’s own scoring and allocation rules of four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters, with and without medical tuning; (iii) a controlled comparison of the effect of medical tuning on calibration, with an exam sat after the model training cutoff as a contamination control; and (iv) evidence on model reasoning and image use in questions with physician commentary and clinical plates.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献是:(一) 从2014至2025年最后12次正式MIR考试中抽取了2 595个问题,包括2023年和2024年电话的答案键、医生评论、临床板和已公布的分数至分数数据;(二) 根据考试本身的评分和分配规则,对4个80至270亿参数的开放式模型进行评价,并配有或不配有医疗调试;(三) 对照医学调试对校准的影响,在模式培训停产后进行考试,作为污染控制;(四) 与医生评论和临床板的问题中使用模型推理和图像的证据。

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLMs on Medical Examinations. Since ChatGPT approached the pass mark of the USMLE [ 21 ] , medical examinations have become the standard showcase for clinical LLMs. MedQA [ 16 ] and its successors track accuracy [ 31 , 32 , 25 ] , and national examinations such as those of Japan [ 20 ] and Spain [ 11 ] have since been added. The MIR in particular is available as a benchmark through HEAD-QA [ 35 , 5 ] , and rheumatologists have rated the reasoning of LLMs on its rheumatology questions [ 22 ] . These studies, however, report accuracy or at most the raw mark, and we are not aware of any that scores a model under the MIR’s penalty and allocation rules, or that separates what a model gains by answering from what it could gain by abstaining.
blocks.zh: 关于体检的法学硕士。 自兹 ChatGPT接近USMLE [21] 的通过标记,医学检查已经成为临床LLMs的标准展示. MeDQA [16] 及其后继者跟踪准确性[31,32,25],以及日本[20]和西班牙[11]等国家考试之后被加入. 特别通过HEAD-QA[35,5]作为基准,风湿病学家对其风湿病学问题的推理进行了评分。 然而,这些研究报告的准确性或最多是原始的,我们不知道有哪个模型在MIR的处罚和分配规则下评分,或者将模型通过回答它可以通过弃权得到什么而得到什么区别开来.

blocks.en: Explanations and Reasoning. A correct answer does not guarantee correct reasoning. GPT-4V was found to give flawed rationales on over a third of the image challenges it answered correctly [ 17 ] , and the explanations a model produces do not necessarily reflect the process that actually led to its answer [ 34 ] . To this end, CasiMedicos provides physician-written explanations of MIR questions that cover the wrong options as well as the right one [ 1 , 9 ] , which makes it possible to ask whether a model rejects each distractor for a clinically valid reason. We grade that reasoning against the physician’s text with an LLM acting as a judge [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 解释与理. 正确的答案不能保证正确的推理。 GPT-4V被发现为超过三分之一的图像挑战给出了有缺陷的理由,它正确回答 [17],一个模型产生的解释并不一定反映实际导致其答案的过程 [34]. 为此,CasiMedicos提供了医生对MIR问题的书面解释,涵盖了错误的选择以及正确的选择[1,9],这使得可以问一个模型是否出于临床上合理的理由拒绝每个分心者. 我们用一个LLM作为法官来判定医生的病历。

blocks.en: Calibration and Abstention. For a model’s confidence to support deferral, it must be both calibrated [ 12 , 24 ] and able to separate right from wrong answers [ 14 ] , a trade-off between coverage and risk formalized by selective prediction [ 7 ] . LLMs do carry some knowledge of their own correctness [ 18 ] , although the confidence they verbalize tends to be overinflated and sycophantic [ 37 ] . It has recently been argued that benchmarks which do not penalize wrong answers reward guessing, and that penalized scoring would instead reward honest abstention [ 19 ] . The MIR provides such a benchmark, with a penalty that makes it possible to ask whether a model can identify the questions it would answer worse than chance, and whether medical fine-tuning improves that ability.
blocks.zh: 校正与弃取. 要使模型的信心支持推迟,必须同时校准[12,24],并能够将正确答案与错误答案区分开来[14],通过选择性预测,在覆盖面与风险之间实现取舍[7]。 LLMs确实携带着一些对自己正确性的知识[18],虽然他们口头表达的信心往往被过度夸大和虚无 [37]. 最近有人争辩说,不惩罚错误答案的基准会奖励猜测,而惩罚性得分则会奖励诚实的弃权[19]。 MIR提供了这样一个基准,并规定了一种惩罚,从而可以问一个模型是否能够识别出它回答的比机会更糟糕的问题,以及医疗微调是否提高了这种能力.

blocks.en: Images and Contamination. Multimodal models have been shown to score well on medical visual questions while ignoring or misreading the image [ 38 , 17 ] . Examination results are also exposed to training data contamination [ 29 ] , for which comparing performance before and after a model’s training cutoff is a standard control [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 影像与污染. 多式联运模型在医学视觉问题上的得分被证明是好的,同时忽略或误读了图像[38.,17]. 考试结果还暴露在培训数据污染中[29],为此,对一个模型的培训停课前后的性能进行比较是一种标准控制[28].

blocks.en: 3.1 Format and Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.1 格式和分数

blocks.en: The MIR is a single, national, multiple-choice examination sat once a year by every graduating physician who seeks a specialty training post in Spain. Following the Ministry of Health, we name each exam by the year of its call, even though it is sat early in the following year, so the 2025 exam, for instance, took place on 24 January 2026. Papers contained 225 scored questions up to the 2018 exam, 175 in 2019 and 2020 and 200 from 2021 onwards, in each case with 10 reserve questions that replace any question annulled by the examining commission. Questions had five options up to the 2014 exam and four thereafter. According to the official scoring rules, a correct answer scores +3, a wrong answer − - 1 and a blank 0, so that the total mark S S is S = 3 ​ c − w , S=3c-w, (1) where c c and w w are the numbers of correct and incorrect answers, respectively. Published results divide this mark by three, giving the net score S / 3 = c − w / 3 S/3=c-w/3 , i.e., the number of correct answers net of the penalty for wrong ones. We report net scores throughout.

blocks.en: Since answering a question that one gets right with probability p p is worth 3 ​ p − ( 1 − p ) = 4 ​ p − 1 3p-(1-p)=4p-1 points, against zero for a blank, it follows that Answer ⇔ p > 1 4 , \text{Answer}\iff p>\tfrac{1}{4}, (2) regardless of the number of options. With four options, a random guess therefore has an expected value of exactly zero, and a blank is better than a guess that is right less than 25% of the time. The relevant question for a model is thus not whether it abstains often enough, but whether it can identify those questions.

blocks.en: 3.2 From Score to Training Post
blocks.zh: 3.2 从记分到培训员额

blocks.en: Candidates are ranked by a total mark that weighs the examination at 90% and the academic record at 10%, with the resulting rank determining the order in which they choose a specialty and a hospital in the national territory, so that each specialty’s cut-off is the rank of the candidate who took its last place. Since the Ministry of Health stopped publishing per-candidate result lists after the 2021 exam, the only public information consists of the per-specialty summaries that the trade press compiles from the allocation [ 3 , 4 ] . For each specialty, these report the mean net score and mean rank of its entrants and, for the 2023 exam, the net score and rank of its last entrant, together with the cut-off and the hospital where the last place went.
blocks.zh: 考生的排名为总分,评分为90%,学术记录为10%,由此得出的排名决定了他们在国内选择专业和医院的顺序,因此每个专业的停课都是最后一位候选人的排名. 由于卫生部在2021年考试后停止公布每个候选人的成绩单,所以唯一的公开信息包括贸易媒体从拨款中汇编的每个专业摘要[3,4]. 每个专业,报告其入职者的平均净分和平均军衔;2023年考试,报告其最后入职者的净分和军衔,以及停产和最后入职的医院.

blocks.en: 4 DATA
blocks.zh: 4个数据

blocks.en: Questions. We parsed the official Version 0 booklets of the last twelve MIR examinations, from 2014 to 2025, containing 2,595 questions including 120 reserves (Table 1 ). Answer keys were taken from the answer tables published by CasiMedicos and from HEAD-QA v2 [ 5 ] , matched on question text. Where both sources key the same question they agree on 730 of 773 cases, and 30 of the 43 disagreements fall in the 2017 exam: the four models’ unanimous answers agree with it on only 36% of questions, against 85–93% in every other year. We therefore start the analysis of RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4 at the 2018 exam, which leaves only four-option papers. Annulled questions are excluded throughout.
blocks.zh: 出问. 我们分析了2014年至2025年最后12次MIR考试的官方版本0小册子,其中载有2 595个问题,包括120个储备(表1)。 回答键取自CasiMedicos公布的回答表和HEAU-QA v2 [5],与问题文本相匹配. 当两个来源都对同一个问题持关键态度时,他们同意773个案例中的730个,43个分歧中有30个在2017年的考试中落下:四个模式的一致回答只同意其中的36%的问题,而其他年份的答案是85–93 % 。 因此,我们在2018年的考试中开始对RQ1,RQ2和RQ4进行分析,这只留下了四个选项的论文. 彻底排除了无端的问题。

blocks.en: Physician Commentary. CasiMedicos also publishes clinician explanations of questions [ 1 , 9 ] , and for some of them, the commentary discusses the wrong options one by one. We use the 123 official questions from the 2015 and 2017–2021 exams whose commentary covers at least two options, since only these can reveal whether a distractor was rejected for the right reason.
blocks.zh: 医学评论. CasiMedicos还出版临床医生对问题的解释[1,9],对于其中一些,评注逐一讨论错误的选项. 我们使用来自2015年和2017-2021年考试的123个官方问题,其评论至少涵盖两个选项,因为只有这些问题才能揭示一个分心者是否因正当理由被拒绝。

blocks.en: Clinical Plates. We extracted the clinical plates from the image annexes of the 2019–2025 exams, the only ones available, obtaining 174 questions with a plate, of which 171 are scorable.
blocks.zh: 临床平板. 我们从2019–2025年测试的图像附件中提取出临床板块,这是唯一可用的,用板块获得174个问题,其中171个是可粘接的.

blocks.en: Specialty Labels. CasiMedicos further assigns each commented question to a specialty, with 619 of the 1,552 scored questions from 2018–2025 (40%) carrying such a label.
blocks.zh: 特产标签. CasiMedicos进一步将每个被评论的问题分配给一个专业,2018–2025年的1,552个得分问题中有619个带有这样的标签.

blocks.en: Rank Data. We built a score-to-rank curve for the 2023 exam (88 points, covering mean and last entrants) and for the 2024 exam (45 points, mean entrants only), together with the cut-offs of their 45 and 44 specialties. The 2025 exam has published cut-offs but no scores yet, and for the 2022 exam, we found cut-offs but no per-specialty scores.
blocks.zh: 军衔数据。 我们为2023年考试(88分,涵盖中入生和最后入生)和2024年考试(45分,仅涉及中入生)搭建了分数至分数曲线,加上他们45分和44分的分数被截断. 2025年的考试已经公布了停课但还没有得分,对于2022年的考试,我们发现停课但没有每个专业的分数.

blocks.en: 5 METHOD
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the study design. Pass A answers every scored question of the 2018–2025 exams in label mode, and serves RQ1 and RQ2. Pass B asks for a reason per option on the questions with physician commentary (RQ3). Pass C repeats the image questions with the plate shown, withheld or swapped (RQ4). blocks.en: 5.1 Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B [ 26 ] together with Gemma-3-27B and MedGemma-27B [ 8 , 30 ] , whose sizes and precisions are listed in Table 2 . All four were released in 2025, before the 2025 exam was sat. Since MedGemma-27B is built on Gemma-3-27B through medical tuning, the pair isolates the effect of that tuning at a fixed scale and architecture, and as both accept images, they are also the two models evaluated in Pass C. All experiments ran on a single 48GB NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000, the kind of hardware a hospital can realistically own and operate. Qwen3’s thinking mode was disabled so that all four models answer directly.
blocks.zh: 我们与Gemma-3-27B和MedGemma-27B[8,30]一起评价了Qune3-8B和Qune3-14B[26],它们的大小和精度见表2。 全部四人于2025年出道,在2025年的考试被坐. 由于MedGemma-27B是通过医学调理来在Gemma-3-27B上建造的,所以配对以固定的尺度和结构隔离了该调音的效果,而作为两者都接受图像,它们也是Pass C中评价的两个模型. 所有实验都运行在单一的48GB NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000上,这种硬件是医院可以现实地拥有和运行的. Quen3的思维模式被禁用,所以所有四个模式都直接回答.

blocks.en: 5.2 Answering Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.2 答复议定书

blocks.en: All prompts are written in Spanish, the language of the examination. The system prompt introduces the model as a MIR candidate and asks it to answer in the language of the question, while the user turn contains the stem and the numbered options. The model is not told about the scoring rule, since abstention is applied afterwards on the basis of its confidence (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 所有提示都用考试语言西班牙语写成。 系统提示引入了模型作为MIR候选人,要求它用问题的语言回答,而用户转会包含干和编号选项. 该模式没有被告知评分规则,因为事后根据其信任适用弃权(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: Label Mode. In this mode, used for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4, the model is asked only for the number of the correct option. In a single forward pass we read the probability q k q_{k} that the model assigns to each option number k k as the first token of its reply and renormalize it over the options, p ^ k = q k / ∑ j q j \hat{p}_{k}=q_{k}/\sum_{j}q_{j} . The answer is then arg ⁡ max k ⁡ p ^ k \arg\max_{k}\hat{p}_{k} and the confidence max k ⁡ p ^ k \max_{k}\hat{p}_{k} , thus derived from the model’s distribution over the options.

blocks.en: Generate Mode. In this mode, used for RQ3, the model is asked for a reply stating, for every option, whether it is the one to mark together with a one sentence clinical reason, followed by the final answer and a stated confidence. Asking whether an option is “the one to mark” rather than whether it is “true” keeps the verdict unambiguous on negatively phrased stems (e.g., “which of the following is FALSE”), which make up about a fifth of the MIR.
blocks.zh: 生成模式。 在用于RQ3的这种模式中,要求该模型提供一份答复,说明每个选项是否与一个句子一起标出临床理由,然后是最后答案和声明的信心。 询问一项选择是否是“要标注的”而不是“真实的”,它是否对消极的词源(例如“以下哪一种是FALSE”)保持了明确的判决,后者占《劳资关系法》的五分之一。

blocks.en: 5.3 Scoring and Placement (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 5.3 计分和安放(RQ1)

blocks.en: Each full-paper run is scored according to ( 1 ) under three answering policies: always hands in every answer, oracle hands in only the correct ones and thus sets the ceiling for a perfectly self-aware model, and calibrated applies the break-even rule of ( 2 ). The latter requires an estimate of p p that the confidence cannot provide, because the largest of four probabilities summing to one is at least 1 / 4 1/4 , so the rule “answer if max k ⁡ p ^ k ≥ 1 / 4 \max_{k}\hat{p}_{k}\geq 1/4 ” would never leave a blank. We therefore estimate p p from the model’s record on its other seven examinations, sorting their answers by confidence into ten equal-sized groups and taking as P ^ ​ ( correct ) \hat{P}(\text{correct}) the accuracy of the group into which a new answer’s confidence falls, so that no examination’s policy is fitted on its own answers. From these policies we derive the abstention gain , calibrated minus always, and the headroom , oracle minus calibrated, that is, the part of the net score that only a more accurate model could recover.
blocks.zh: 每一次全纸跑都按照三个答题政策( 1 ) 得分: 每一次答题总是用手, 甲骨文只用正确的, 后者要求对p作出信任不能提供的p的估计,因为四个概率中最大的一个是至少1/4 1/4,因此,规则“如果最大 k =  p p ^ k → 1 / 4 max_{k}\t{p}_{k}\k}\geq 1/4 )永远不会留下空白。 因此,我们从模型在其他七次考试的记录中估计p, 将它们的答案按信心排序为十个等大小的组别, 并将新答案落到的组别准确性作为P^(正确)\hat{P}(\text{更正), 以免考试政策本身的答案适应。 我们从这些政策中获得弃权收益, 校准减数, 和头室,甲骨文减分, 即净分中只有更准确的模型才能恢复的部分。

blocks.en: To place a model in the national ranking, we fit a score-to-rank curve for each exam through the published points and interpolate linearly between the resulting knots. A specialty is considered open at a given rank if its last place went to that rank or a later one, so the most competitive open specialty is the best choice still available, and the hospital that took its last place is where it remained available at the end. Mapping the 95% interval of the net score through the curve then gives the corresponding range of ranks.
blocks.zh: 为了在全国排名中放置一个模型,我们通过公布的分数为每次考试设置一个分数到分数的曲线,并在产生的节相之间线性地插入. 如果某专业的最后位置进入了该级别或后来的级别,则该专业被视为在某一级别上开放,所以最具竞争力的开放专业是目前尚可选择的最佳选择,而占据其最后位置的医院则是最终仍然可以使用的地方. 通过曲线绘制95%的净分数间隔,然后给出相应的排名范围.

blocks.en: 5.4 Calibration (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 5.4 校准(RQ2)

blocks.en: For each model, we report accuracy, mean confidence, expected calibration error (ECE, with ten equal bins) [ 24 ] , the multi-class Brier score over the option distribution [ 2 ] , and the area under the ROC curve (AUROC) with which confidence separates right from wrong answers [ 14 ] . Whereas ECE measures whether confidence matches accuracy on average, AUROC measures whether it ranks answers correctly. The main contrast is between MedGemma-27B and Gemma-3-27B on the same questions. As a contamination control, we also report every measure separately for the pre-release examinations, whose questions have circulated publicly for years, and for the 2025 exam, which was sat after all four models had been released.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,我们报告准确性,平均置信度,预期校正误差(ECE,有10个等分箱)[24],多级布赖尔得分超过选项分配[2],以及ROC曲线下的信任度将正与错误答案相区分的区域[14]. 欧洲经委会衡量信任是否与平均准确性相符,而欧统办衡量其是否正确回答。 主要的对比点是MedGemma-27B和Gemma-3-27B在同样问题上. 作为污染控制,我们还就释放前的考试和2025年的考试分别报告每一项措施,因为前期考试的问题已经公开流传多年,2025年的考试在所有四个模式都公布之后都进行了。

blocks.en: 5.5 Rationale Grading (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 5.5 理由认定(RQ3)

blocks.en: Each model performs one generate mode run over the 123 questions with commentaries on two or more options. For every option that has both a physician span and a model reason, an external judge , i.e., a Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct [ 10 ] in 4-bit precision, is shown the question, the options, the key, the model’s verdict on the option, the physician’s text for it and the model’s reason, and labels the reason as same if it gives the physician’s key clinical reason, valid if it gives a different but clinically correct and sufficient one, or wrong if it is clinically wrong, unsupported, irrelevant or too vague, or argues for the wrong verdict. Because the reasons are graded against the physician’s commentary, RQ3 is limited to the 108 questions on which the physician’s answer matches the exam key. Our main measure of interest, right answer, wrong reason , is the share of correctly answered questions on which at least one distractor was rejected for a reason labelled wrong, with which we compare the label mode confidence of these answers with that of correct answers whose distractor reasons were all sound.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都采用一个生成模式,对123个问题进行计算,并就两个或两个以上选项提出评论。 对于每个既具有医生跨度又具有模型理由的选项,外聘法官(即Llama-3.3-70B-Instructiont [10])在4位精确度中,都显示问题,选项,关键,模型对选项的判断,医生的文本和模型的理由,如果给出医生的关键临床理由,如果给出一个不同但临床正确和足够的理由,则标出相同的理由,如果给出一个不同但临床正确和足够的理由,或者如果临床错误,没有支持,无关或过于模糊,或者为错误的判决辩护,则将理由标出相同. RQ3仅限于医生回答的108个问题, 我们的主要利益度量,正确答案,错误的理由, 是正确回答的问题的一部分, 其中至少有一个分心者被拒绝的原因被贴上错误的标签,

blocks.en: 5.6 Image Conditions (RQ4)
blocks.zh: 5.6 图像条件(RQ4)

blocks.en: The two vision models answer the 171 image questions in label mode under three conditions, i.e., with the question’s own plate, with no plate, and with the plate of a different question. We report accuracy per condition, the paired difference between the real plate and each alternative, the share of answers that change, and the share of questions answered correctly in all three conditions, for which the text alone is evidently sufficient.
blocks.zh: 两个视觉模型在三个条件下在标签模式中解答了171个图像问题,即用问题自己的盘子,没有盘子,用不同问题的盘子. 我们报告每个条件的准确性,真实盘和每个选项之间的对接差异,改变的答案的比例,以及在所有三个条件中正确回答的问题的比例,对于这三项条件,文本本身显然就足够了.

blocks.en: 5.7 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.7 统计分析

blocks.en: All confidence intervals are 95% intervals computed over questions, so they express how much a measure would change had a different set of questions been asked. Since every answer is deterministic, this is the only source of variation. For proportions, namely the accuracies and the RQ3 rate, we use Wilson intervals [ 36 ] . For the measures that are not simple proportions (e.g., net score, ECE, Brier score and AUROC), and for the difference between two values of any measure, we use a percentile bootstrap with 2,000 resamples of the questions [ 6 ] . Two kinds of difference arise. When both values come from the same questions, as in MedGemma-27B minus Gemma-3-27B and in the real plate minus each alternative, the questions are resampled once and both values recomputed on them (a paired bootstrap). When they come from different questions, as in the 2025 exam minus the earlier ones and in the RQ3 confidence gap, the two sets are resampled independently.
blocks.zh: 所有置信间隔都是通过提问计算出来的95%的间隔,因此表示如果提出不同的一组问题,某项措施会改变多少. 由于每个答案都是决定性的,这是唯一的变异源. 对于比例,即速率和RQ3率,我们使用威尔逊间隔[36]. 对于不是简单比例的衡量标准(如净分数、欧洲经委会、Brier分数和AUROC分数),以及任何衡量标准的两个值之间的差别,我们使用一个有2,000个问题复标的百分位靴。 二种差别相出. 当两个值都来自相同的问题,如在MedGemma-27B中减去Gemma-3-27B,在正盘中减去每个替代品时,问题被重印一次,两个值都重刻在上(一对靴子). 当它们来自不同的问题时,如2025年的考试中减去了更早的考试和RQ3信任差距时,这两套被独立地被重印.

blocks.en: As for significance tests, two models or two image conditions answering the same questions are compared with McNemar’s exact test [ 23 ] , which considers only the questions on which the two disagree. The RQ3 rates, in contrast, are computed over each model’s own correct answers and therefore over different questions, so we compare them with Fisher’s exact test. Because this comparison involves all six pairs of the four models, its six p p -values are corrected with Holm’s adjustment [ 15 ] . No other test in the paper is adjusted.
blocks.zh: 至于意义测试,两个模型或两个图像条件回答同样的问题被与麦克内马尔的精确测试[23]相比较,后者只考虑两个有分歧的问题. 反之,RQ3的费率是根据每个模型自己的正确答案计算,因此也根据不同的问题计算,因此我们将它们与费舍尔的准确测试进行比较。 由于这一比较涉及这四个模型中的所有六对,因此它的六个p-值会随着霍尔姆的调整而得到纠正[15]. 纸上没有其他测试内容调整.

blocks.en: 6 RESULTS
blocks.zh: 6项结果

blocks.en: 6.1 RQ1: Scored Like a Real Candidate
blocks.zh: 6.1 RQ1: 得分如真正的候选人

blocks.en: When answering every question, Gemma-3-27B and Qwen3-14B obtain an average net score per examination of 131.3 and 131.0, respectively, followed by MedGemma-27B with 125.5 and Qwen3-8B with 95.8, with a 95% interval of roughly ± \pm 16 on any single examination. Since the eight examinations differ in length, from 172 to 221 scored questions, Table 3 reports the net score per 100 questions over all 1,552 of them, which is 67.7, 67.5, 64.7 and 49.4 for the same four models. Furthermore, Figure 2 and Table 4 show how these net scores map to the 2023 and 2024 score-to-rank curves. In 2023, Gemma-3-27B’s net score of 142.7 maps to an estimated rank of about 1,628, at which 43 of the 45 specialties were still open, the most competitive being Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery. Qwen3-14B lands close behind with the same choice, whereas MedGemma-27B would reach Cardiology and Qwen3-8B, with 22 specialties left, Haematology. In 2024 the three larger models reach ranks between about 600 and 1,400, with Plastic Surgery or Ophthalmology still open. These ranges are nonetheless wide, since a single examination places a model in the 95% interval of roughly 2,000 ranks, and the 2024 curve, which is based on only 45 points, places any given score markedly higher than the 2023 curve (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 在回答每个问题时,Gemma-3-27B和Qwen3-14B的考试平均净分分别为131.3分和131.0分,其次是MedGemma-27B的125.5分和Qwen3-8B的95.8分,任何一次考试的间隔为95%左右为±\pm 16分. 由于这8个考试的长度不同,从172分到221分的得分问题,表3报告所有1,552个考试的每100个考试的得分净额为67.7分,67.5分,64.7分和49.4分相同4个模式. 此外,图2和表4显示了这些净分数如何映射出2023和2024分到分数的曲线. 2023年,Gemma-3-27B的净分数为142.7张地图,估计排名约为1,628张,其中45个专业中有43个仍然开放,竞争最多的是口腔外科和Maxillofacial外科. Qune3-14B以同一种选择相接而后着陆,而MedGemma-27B则会到达心地学和Qune3-8B,剩下22个专业,海马生理学. 2024年,三大型号达到600至1400左右,可塑外科或眼科仍然开放. 尽管如此,这些幅度还是很宽的,因为单次考试将一个模型置于大约2,000分的95%的间隔中,而仅基于45分的2024曲线将任何给定分明显地高于2023曲线(第8节)。

blocks.en: Abstention, on the other hand, never helps. The calibrated policy answers every question on every examination, so the abstention gain is zero for all 32 model-examination pairs. This is not because confidence is uninformative, since it separates right from wrong answers with an AUROC of 0.80 for the three larger models and 0.76 for Qwen3-8B (Table 5 ), but because even the least confident tenth of each model’s answers on its other examinations was right 29–47% of the time, above the 25% threshold of ( 2 ). Indeed, skipping the least confident tenth chosen in hindsight within each examination would have lowered the net score on 28 of the 32 pairs and gained at most 3.7 on the others. Figure 3 illustrates why: the net score rises almost monotonically as answers are added from most to least confident. The net score lost to wrong answers, 15.7–24.5 per examination (8.1–12.7 per 100 questions), is thus headroom that a more accurate model could recover.

blocks.en: 6.2 RQ2: Medical Tuning and Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 6.2 RQ2:医疗训练与不确定性

blocks.en: All four models are overconfident (Figure 4 ), with a mean confidence of 0.91–0.99 against an accuracy of 0.62–0.76 and an ECE of 0.21–0.29 (Table 5 ). Below a confidence of 0.9, in fact, accuracy falls under 0.5 in all but one of the bins with at least ten answers. Medical tuning, however, changed the level of confidence. Over all eight examinations, MedGemma-27B is 2.3 points less accurate than Gemma-3-27B on the same questions ( p = 0.027 p=0.027 ) and 0.047 less confident, which lowers its ECE by 0.026 [0.005, 0.045]. Its AUROC, however, is essentially unchanged, with a difference of +0.002 [ − - 0.025, +0.028], so it is no better at telling its right answers from its wrong ones. Given that no confidence-based abstention pays on this examination (RQ1), the lower ECE brings no gain in net score, whereas the loss of accuracy costs about 3 points of net score per 100 questions.

On the 2025 exam, which none of the models may have seen during training, all are at least as accurate as on the older exams, by 1.2 to 4.9 points (Table 5 ), and its mean confidence matches that on the older exams to within 0.003. blocks.en: 6.3 RQ3: Right Answers, Wrong Reasons
blocks.zh: 6.3 RQ3:正确答案、错误理由

blocks.en: A correct answer frequently rests on a distractor rejected for a wrong reason (Figure 6 , Table 6 ). This occurs on 38% [27, 51] of the correct answers of Qwen3-8B, compared with 19% [12, 29] for Qwen3-14B, 15% [9, 25] for MedGemma-27B and 13% [7, 24] for Gemma-3-27B. After Holm’s adjustment, Qwen3-8B differs from Gemma-3-27B ( p = 0.011 p=0.011 ) and from MedGemma-27B ( p = 0.024 p=0.024 ) and falls just short of significance against Qwen3-14B (unadjusted p = 0.013 p=0.013 , adjusted 0.053), while no other pair differs. In particular, Gemma-3-27B and MedGemma-27B do not ( p = 0.81 p=0.81 before adjustment), so medical tuning did not change how often distractors are dismissed for wrong reasons. Across all distractor reasons, the judge labels 64–74% as valid, 14–18% as the same as the physician’s and 11–21% as wrong.
blocks.zh: 正确的答案往往取决于因错误原因被拒绝的分心者(图6,表6)。 这发生在Qwen3-8B正确答案的38% [27,51],而Quen3-14B正确答案的19% [12,29],MedGemma-27B正确答案的15% [9,25],Gemma-3-27B正确答案的13% [7,24]. 在霍尔姆调整后,Quen3-8B与Gemma-3-27B(p = 0.011 p = 0.011)和MedGemma-27B(p = 0.024 p = 0.024)不同,与Quen3-14B(未调整p = 0.013 p = 0.013,已调整0.053)相比,其意义恰好相去甚远,而其他一对无一相差. 特别是Gemma-3-27B和MedGemma-27B在调整前没有(p=0.81 p=0.81),因此医学调理没有改变分心者因错误原因被解职的频率. 在所有分散注意力的原因中,法官都称64–74 %为有效,14–18 %为医生,11–21 %为错误。

blocks.en: Moreover, the models’ confidence does not reflect these errors. The confidence of correct answers reached with a wrongly rejected distractor is no lower than that of correct answers with sound reasons, the difference ranging from − - 0.004 to +0.020 (Table 6 ) with only Qwen3-14B’s interval, [+0.002, +0.031], excluding zero, and in the wrong direction. The stated confidence in generate mode does not separate them either. Likewise, asking for a reason per option also changes the answers themselves. On the same 108 questions, generate mode is 4–5 points less accurate than label mode for three of the models and 15 points less accurate for Gemma-3-27B (from 0.77 to 0.62).
blocks.zh: 此外,模型的信心没有反映这些错误。 用被错误拒绝的分心器所达到的正确答案的信心不低于有合理理由的正确答案,区别范围从−-0.004到+0.020(表6),只有Qune3-14B的间隔[+0.002,+0.031],排除了零,方向错误. 对生成模式表示的信心也没有将它们分开。 同样,要求每个选项的理由也会改变答案本身。 在同一108个问题上,生成模式为3个模型的4-5分差于标签模式,而Gemma-3-27B的15分差(从0.77分到0.62分).

blocks.en: Table 7 illustrates the judge’s grading of distractor reasons. In the first two examples the model’s reason is clinically wrong , since pulmonary fibrosis is a classic cause of digital clubbing and diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis is diagnosed radiographically. The third example, in contrast, shows a judge error: on a “which statement is true” stem, the model rejects the statement that proteinuria above 500mg/24h is unlikely by arguing that proteinuria is in fact likely, which is also the physician’s reason, and yet the judge labels this wrong for three of the four models. The judge can thus misread a reason that negates a negatively worded option, which inflates the wrong-reason rate for every model.
blocks.zh: 表7说明了法官分级分散注意力的原因。 在前两个例子中,模型的病因在临床上是错误的,因为肺纤维化是数字化的古典病因,而分泌的异病性骨骼性高血压则被放射诊断出。 与此相反,第三个例子显示了一个法官的错误:在“哪个声明是真实的”这一干线上,模型拒绝关于蛋白质超过500mg/24h的说法,认为蛋白质有可能,这也是医生的理由,然而法官却将这四个模型中的三个标注错了。 因此,法官可以错误地理解一个否定一种负面措辞的选择的理由,这种选择夸大了每个模型的错误理由率。

blocks.en: 6.4 RQ4: Use of the Clinical Image
blocks.zh: 6.4 RQ4:临床图像的使用

blocks.en: The clinical images available along questions make no measurable difference in terms of model accuracy (Figure 7 ). Gemma-3-27B answers 67.8% of the 171 image questions correctly with the real plate, 69.6% with no plate and 67.3% with another question’s plate, and MedGemma-27B 62.6%, 64.9% and 63.2%, respectively. Relative to no plate, the real plate thus changes accuracy by − - 1.8 points [ − - 7.0, +2.9] and − - 2.3 points [ − - 7.6, +2.4] ( p = 0.65 p=0.65 and 0.50 0.50 ), so it adds at most about 3 points, and it stays within 0.6 points of a mismatched plate ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 for both). The plate is not ignored outright, since it changes 13–20% of the answers, but the gains and losses cancel each other out, and 58% (Gemma) and 56% (MedGemma) of the image questions are answered correctly in all three conditions, i.e., from the text alone.

blocks.en: 7 DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 7个讨论

blocks.en: Penalty Is Too Mild to Reward Self-Knowledge. Penalized scoring has been proposed as a remedy for benchmarks that reward guessing [ 19 ] , and the MIR illustrates the limits of this approach. With a reward a a for a right answer and a penalty b b for a wrong one, answering every question is optimal whenever p > b / ( a + b ) p>b/(a+b) , i.e., 0.25 for the MIR. Models whose least confident answers are right a third of the time therefore never benefit from abstaining, however good their confidence may be, and the examination cannot distinguish a model that knows what it does not know from one that does not. A clinical deployment, in contrast, faces much steeper penalties, since a wrong recommendation that is acted upon can cost far more than a deferral. In that setting the break-even rises towards one, and the ability of confidence to rank errors, here an AUROC of about 0.80, becomes decisive and should be reported alongside.
blocks.zh: 惩罚太迟钝了 无法奖励自我认识 有人提议,惩罚性评分是奖励猜测的基准[19]的补救办法,而MIR说明了这一方法的局限性。 以对正确答案的奖励a和对错误答案的处罚bb,只要p > b (a + b) p > b (a + b),即为MIR的0.25,就最好回答每个问题。 因此,最不自信的答案恰好是三分之一时间的模型从未因弃权而受益,无论他们的信心如何好,而且考试不能将知道自己不知道的模型与不知道的模型区分开来。 与此相反,临床部署面临更严厉的惩罚,因为对错误的建议采取行动的代价远不止于推迟。 由此,一个大约为0.80的AUROC就具有决定性作用,应该同时报告。

blocks.en: Medical Tuning Is Not a Safety Proxy. In the absence of a penalty that rewards self-knowledge, a hospital may be tempted to assume that a medical model is safer than its base model. In our experiments, MedGemma-27B was less overconfident than its base model, which may be taken as a sign of better self-knowledge. However, the improvement came from lowering confidence across the board rather than from a better knowledge of which answers were wrong, and it came at a cost in accuracy . A hospital choosing between a general model and its medical variant should thus test both on task and on language , rather than assume that the medical label brings better judgement.
blocks.zh: 医疗通灵不是安全代理 在没有奖励自我知识的惩罚的情况下,医院可能会被诱惑认为医疗模式比其基本模式更安全. 在我们的实验中,MedGemma-27B的过度自信不如其基础模型,这可以被看作更好的自我知识的标志. 然而,改进来自全面降低信心,而不是更好地了解答案是错误的,其代价是准确性。 因此,医院在一般型号及其医疗变体之间作出选择,应该对任务和语言进行检验,而不是假定医疗标签能带来更好的判断。

blocks.en: Explanations Need to Be Checked. When a model’s explanation is shown to a clinician or a student, between 13 and 38% of its correct answers come with a distractor dismissed for a wrong reason. In medical education, where the explanation is the main object of interest, this is a serious flaw, and in clinical deployment, it is a safety concern. The model’s confidence does not reveal it, and the judge’s grading shows that the problem is not limited to a single model. Asking for explanations also changed the answers, by 15 points for one model, so an evaluation in which the model is asked to explain its answer may not reflect its performance when it is not.
blocks.zh: 解释需要检查。 当模特儿向临床医生或学生展示其解释时,13%至38%的正确答案会因错误原因被解职。 在医学教育中,以解释为主要关注对象,这是一个严重的缺陷,在临床部署中,这是一个安全关切. 模型的信心并没有揭示出来,法官的分级显示问题不仅限于单一模型. 要求解释也改变了答案,一个模型的答案为15分,因此要求该模型解释其答案的评价可能不会反映其表现时的成绩.

blocks.en: Images Are Optional on This Examination. More than half of the image questions were answered correctly without any image, and neither model used the images to improve accuracy. For clinical use, this implies that the ability to accept an image is no evidence that the model ultimately looks at it, and that image dependent tasks require their own evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图片在本次考试中是可选的 。 超过半数的图像问题在没有任何图像的情况下得到正确回答,两个模型都没有使用图像来提高准确性. 对于临床用途来说,这意味着接受一幅图像的能力并不是模型最终看它的证据,而图像依赖任务需要他们自己的评价.

blocks.en: 8 LIMITATIONS
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Judge Validation. No physician has rated the judge’s grading, and Table 7 shows that the judge errs on reasons that negate negatively worded options. Physician ratings of a blind sample, as well as the expert ratings of LLM reasoning available for rheumatology questions [ 22 ] , would provide a more reliable estimate. In addition, RQ3 excludes the 15 questions whose physician answer differs from the exam key, and covers pre-release examinations only.
blocks.zh: 判官审正. 没有医生对法官的评级进行评分,表7显示法官错误地否定了消极措辞的选择。 物理学家对一盲样的收视率,以及针对风湿病学问题提供的LLM推理的专家收视率[22],将提供一个更可靠的估计. 此外,RQ3不包括医生回答的15个问题与考试钥匙不同,只包括释放前的检查.

blocks.en: Ranks Are Estimates. Since the rank combines the examination with the academic record, a rank read off the net score assumes a typical record. Moreover, the 2024 curve rests on specialty means only and, at an equal score, yields a much better rank than the 2023 curve, so its placements should be read as optimistic .
blocks.zh: 军衔是估计。 由于军衔将考试与学术记录相结合,因此从净分中读取的军衔就假定了典型的记录. 此外,2024年曲线仅靠特长,在等分时,其分数比2023年曲线高得多,因此其投放应被解读为乐观. .

blocks.en: Scope. Our study covers four open models of 8–27B parameters, a single prompt in Spanish and direct answering, so larger or reasoning models may behave differently. The Gemma pair ran in 8-bit precision and the Qwen models in 16-bit, although the Gemma models were tested in equal conditions. Confidence is measured as a probability over the options, and verbalized or sampled confidence may behave differently. Finally, images are available only from 2019 onwards, and the 2017 exam is excluded from RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4 because of parsing issues.
blocks.zh: 范围。 我们的研究包括4个开放的8–27B参数模型,一个西班牙语的单个快取和直接回答,因此较大或推理模型的行为可能有所不同. Gemma一对以8位精度运行,而Quen一对以16位精度运行,尽管Gemma模式在同等条件下进行了测试. 信心被测量为对选择的一种概率,而口头或抽样信任的行为可能有所不同。 最后,从2019年起,图像才提供,而2017年的考试因解析问题被从RQ1,RQ2和RQ4中排除.

blocks.en: 9 CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Scored as real candidates, open models that a hospital can run on its own hardware would pass the Spanish residency examination with room to spare and could choose almost any specialty. That score, however, reveals little of what a health system needs to know before relying on them. The exam’s penalty is too mild for any of these models to benefit from abstaining, so it cannot reward a model for knowing its limits, and medical tuning lowered confidence without improving the models’ self-knowledge, and it cost accuracy. Likewise, up to 38% of correct answers rested on distractors rejected for a wrong reason, which the models’ confidence did not reveal, and the provided clinical images made no difference to accuracy. Taken together, these show that a model can match into a residency while being overconfident, right for the wrong reasons, and indifferent to the images it is shown. Evaluations intended to support clinical deployment should therefore look beyond the score, reporting how well confidence ranks errors, verifying the reasoning behind correct answers, and testing the use of images directly. Validating the rationale judge against physician ratings and extending the analysis to larger and reasoning models are natural next steps.
blocks.zh: 被评为真正的候选者,医院可以用自己的硬件运行的开放型号会通过西班牙居住证的检查,留有空位,并且可以选择几乎任何特长. 然而,这一成绩表明,卫生系统在依赖它们之前,并不需要知道什么。 考试的处罚太轻,任何一种模式都无法从弃权中获益,因此不能奖励知道其限度的模型,医学调整降低了信心而不提高模型的自知性,并且花费了准确性。 同样,高达38%的正确答案依赖于因错误原因被拒绝的分心者,而模型的信心并没有揭示这一点,所提供的临床图像对准确性没有影响。 综合起来,这些显示一个模型可以匹配到一个居住区,同时过度自信,由于错误的原因正确,并且对所显示的图像漠不关心. 因此,旨在支持临床部署的评价应超越得分范围,报告信任程度如何对错误进行评级,核实正确答案背后的理由,并直接测试图像的使用。 对照医生的评级来验证理由判断,并将分析范围扩大到更大的推理模型,这自然是下一步的步骤。
